element.label: Metro Turnstile Scan Event
element.name: x_mtts_scan_event
element.comments: Audited verification history of ticket scans at metro turnstiles and handheld inspectors

element.label: Ticket Number
element.name: ticket_number
element.comments: Issued ticket number presented during scan

element.label: Booking Ticket
element.name: booking_ticket
element.comments: Foreign key reference to booking record

element.label: Station Code
element.name: station_code
element.comments: Operational station code where scan occurred

element.label: Scanner ID
element.name: scanner_id
element.comments: Turnstile device or handheld terminal identifier

element.label: Verification Outcome
element.name: verification_outcome
element.comments: Outcome: VALID, TOKEN_MISMATCH, TICKET_NOT_FOUND, TICKET_CANCELLED_OR_INVALID, INVALID_REQUEST, UNAUTHORIZED, RATE_LIMITED, INTERNAL_ERROR

element.label: Client IP
element.name: client_ip
element.comments: Network IP address of the scanner client

element.label: Scan Timestamp
element.name: scan_timestamp
element.comments: Precise UTC timestamp of scan verification
